title: YARA：無害標記、字串條件與反例設計
titleEn: YARA: inert markers, string conditions and negative fixtures
subcategoryTitle: 偵測邏輯與端點證據品質

scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

以本課決策條件作有條件結論：僅建立含ALPHA、BETA、GAMMA三個無害標記的文字fixture；對「至少兩個標記」列完整存在/不存在真值表，另外測空檔與文字編碼。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: YARA以字串與條件描述檔案特徵；命中表示符合規則，不自動等於惡意程式。
knowledge.textEn: YARA describes file features using strings and conditions; a match is not automatically proof of malware.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 僅建立含ALPHA、BETA、GAMMA三個無害標記的文字fixture；對「至少兩個標記」列完整存在/不存在真值表，另外測空檔與文字編碼。
knowledge.textEn: Create text fixtures containing harmless ALPHA, BETA and GAMMA markers; enumerate presence/absence truth tables for at least two markers and separately test empty files and encoding.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: m個獨立布林標記有2^m種組合；存在性邏輯、字串邊界與編碼需分別驗證，樣本不可包含可執行惡意內容。
knowledge.textEn: m independent Boolean markers give 2^m combinations; test existence logic, word boundaries and encoding separately using no executable malicious content.
